conventions.exit: close after h sessions of exposure, same series as the entry
conventions.regret: outcome(alternative) - outcome(actual): signed, never a max
conventions.cohorts: each scaled to PROBE_GROSS_CAP; net excess over SPY and over the same-band equal-weight panel mean; by session with t and MDE
conventions.cost_model: xs_ranker.round_trip_bps (frozen mdv, else the panel's 60-bar median before the session); zero refused
conventions.breaks: a window step > max(0.25 log, 8.0 sigma) is REFUSED
